Football Club \"Kalamata\" is a Greek professional football club based in Kalamata, Messenia. They compete in the Super League Greece 2, the second tier of the Greek football league system. The club's home ground is the Kalamata Metropolitan Stadium. From the 2026–27 season, the club will play in the Super League Greece after being promoted in the 2025–26 season, for the first time in 25 years.
